FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Sweet Indulgence Dessert Shop, we specialize in creating a wide variety of delectable desserts including cakes, pastries, cookies, and seasonal specialties. Our operations focus primarily on retail sales, with a commitment to quality and customer satisfaction. We ensure a clean and safe environment by maintaining all necessary health department permits and adhering to strict food safety protocols. While we offer a limited selection of alcoholic beverages, our alcohol service is secondary to our dessert sales, and we have all required licenses in place for compliance. All staff serving alcohol are trained and certified in responsible service. Our team consists of experienced individuals in the food service industry, enabling us to effectively manage operations while enhancing customer experience. Additionally, we regularly conduct equipment maintenance and implement risk management strategies to mitigate any potential hazards in our operations.

Our dessert shop offers a selection of gourmet desserts paired with fine wines, which enhances the overall dining experience for our customers.
